lines: See: Tips for running from the Song Library

This song is just like name-that-note, but it uses "placed single note" as the ArpeggioPlugin type: /fpat placed single By default, it has SingleNotes placed at the Nut, 5th, 7th, and 12th frets, since in P4 this gives the perfect fourth, the perfect fifth, and the octave. This is nick-named "Perfect Frets" in this Song. To change which placed SingleNotes by Section the Song uses, chose different pre-programmed groupings of "fret flavors" with the buttons in the SongWidgets: "Perfect frets", "Diamond frets", "Black Keys", "White Keys" and "All Notes". The "Keys" flavors correspond to white keys and black keys on the piano.

Also on by default is /fpan named which shows [all named] matching NamedNotes on the neck in the current range upon Reveal, and [one] which just shows one note on Reveal. These both use /fpa extra clear beat which gives you an extra beat to admire the revealed notes before clearing and showing the next prompt highlight.
Default is P4, positions [0,12], and Transposition off.  Use the links below to set other Tunings, Positions, and Transpositions.
